cues: On mild spring mornings, the riverside trail fills with commuters seeking fresh air and alternatives to crowded roads.
A neighborhood repair shop opens early on Saturdays, when families bring worn tires and loose chains for attention.
After the train doors open, passengers head toward offices, cafés, and nearby streets for the final stretch.
Local officials debate whether a quiet residential route can connect homes with schools and shopping areas.
On sunny weekends, the park’s rental kiosk attracts visitors eager to explore nearby paths at their own pace.
A small roadside pump stands beside the trail for travelers needing a quick adjustment before continuing.
